archetypes.name: dyn-checks-identity
archetypes.rationale: Stale bgjob rejoin and child identity drift are easy to miss across two launchers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect checks_result_identity classification and both run-step-checks.sh and step-6-entry.sh rejoin paths. Confirm matching failed results may rejoin only when HEAD and tree fingerprint match, live identity mismatches fail closed without duplicate launch, and child pre-check plus pre-publish revalidation emit non-reusable identity-integrity-failed envelopes. Also verify dispatch_commit_route always passes validated REPO_ROOT and binds cwd/CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR away from ambient project dirs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
